title: North Korea Delivers First KN-30 Ballistic Missiles to Russia's Voronezh Oblast
detail: Ukraine's Defense Intelligence (HUR) confirmed on August 20 that Russia received its first shipment of North Korean Hwasong-11C (KN-30) short-range ballistic missiles, deployed alongside a North Korean missile unit of roughly 90 personnel operating six transporter-erector-launchers in Voronezh Oblast, western Russia. The KN-30 carries a 2,500kg warhead with roughly 900km range, putting Ukraine's Kyiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, and Zaporizhzhia regions within range. ISW said it had not yet seen evidence of Russia using the KN-30 against Ukraine, assessing Moscow is likely 'saving' its expanded ballistic and cruise missile stock for periodic mass attacks designed to overwhelm Ukraine's air defenses. North Korea had transferred around 50 KN-23/KN-24/KN-30 missiles to Russia by mid-2026.

title: Russia Launches Massive Missile-and-Drone Barrage on Kyiv, Killing at Least 15
detail: Russia launched an hours-long overnight barrage of ballistic missiles (including Kinzhal and Banderol), cruise missiles, and jet-powered drones at Kyiv and the surrounding oblast beginning shortly after midnight on August 20, striking 28 locations across the capital. At least 15 people were killed and around 40 injured, according to President Zelensky, with explosions reported in the Solomianskyi, Sviatoshynskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, Desnianskyi, and Dniprovskyi districts. A nine-storey residential building partially collapsed and caught fire in Solomianskyi, and a children's hospital was damaged with windows blown out and vehicles burning on its grounds. Ukraine's Air Force said it intercepted 39 of 44 ballistic missiles launched. Zelensky called it 'a massive attack' combining multiple missile types 'to cause as much damage as possible to civilian infrastructure.'
